title: Yellowmoon camera profile
description: data/cameras/profiles/<profile-id>/profile.json, generated by training/sensor_map/build_profiles.py (docs/02, docs/03). Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by training/sensor_map/validate_profiles.py and listed under 'Also required' in each description: strictly increasing 'mired' inside every class list, rows of every sensor-map matrix summing to 1 (white preservation, within 1e-12), green exactly 1 in every w_A, grids with the lengths implied by their ranges. Interpolation rules for the Rust runtime: training/sensor_map/README.md and training/sensor_map/runtime_ref.py.

id.description: Profile id; equals the folder name and the registry's profile id.

version.description: Semver of this profile; written into every export's XMP. Bump when any number changes.

display_name.description: Short body name shown in the app, for example 'A7R IV'.

spectral_curves.description: Measured curves, path relative to data/cameras/ (rawtoaces-data JSON format, Weta, Apache-2.0).

sensor_map.description: Per-light white-preserving 3x3 maps from white-balanced camera RGB to white-balanced ALEXA RGB (docs/02 C2). Runtime: M_map = sum_k p_k M_k(mired); M_k interpolates linearly in mired between the two bracketing entries of class k and clamps at the ends.

target.description: Target description, path relative to data/ (data/alexa/target.json).

locus.description: Camera locus of the scene-light models (docs/02 'Camera RGB <-> CCT and Duv'): camera RGB (green = 1) of blackbody 1500-4000 K and CIE daylight 4000-25000 K every 10 K, as log-chroma, with the matching CIE 1931 xy and the Duv scale.

axes.description: Meaning of the two numbers in each 'values' row.

blackbody.description: Blackbody locus, start_k 1500, end 4000 K. Also required: values strictly monotone along the branch.

daylight.description: CIE daylight locus (D series with the rawtoaces CCT correction), start_k 4000, end 25000 K.

xy.description: CIE 1931 xy of the same lights, same grids, from the 5 nm spectra.

duv_scale.description: CIE 1960 uv distance per unit of log-chroma distance measured across the locus (provenance.duv_scale_method), as a function of temperature: blackbody 1500-4000 K and daylight 4000-25000 K, 100 K step, scalar values, interpolated linearly in mired like the locus. Duv = signed log-chroma distance to the locus * scale(CCT of the foot point).

duv_sign.description: Duv is positive toward magenta, which is the opposite sign of CIE's convention (positive above the locus, toward green). In log-chroma space the positive direction is the locus tangent (increasing temperature) rotated by -90 degrees: n = (t_y, -t_x).

alexa_white.description: w_A = S_A^T E / (S_A^T E)_G, the ALEXA estimate's white for a light, as [r, 1, b] (docs/02 C3-C4). Does not depend on the camera but is stored here so a second target can be versioned with the profiles fitted against it. Blackbody and daylight on a 10 K grid; fluorescent and LED reference lights as (mired, w) lists sorted by mired.

blackbody.description: Blackbody, start_k 1500, end 25000 K. Runtime interpolation: geometric in mired, w = w_i^(1-a) * w_(i+1)^a with a = (1/T - 1/T_i) / (1/T_(i+1) - 1/T_i). The scene-light rule (blackbody below 4000 K, daylight from 4000 K) only uses this table below 4000 K.

daylight.description: CIE daylight, start_k 4000, end 25000 K. Same interpolation.

quirks.description: Per-body decode quirks carried as data (docs/03 'Per-camera code hook'). Empty for all V1 profiles.

fit_script.description: 'training/sensor_map/fit.py@<git sha>': the commit the working tree was based on when the profile was generated ('unknown' outside a checkout).

fit_sources_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the fit script sources (see build_profiles.FIT_SOURCES); identifies the code even when the tree was not committed.

reference_lights.description: Names of the reference lights per class, in table order (equals the 'light' fields of sensor_map.classes).

cie_data.description: States that CIE SPDs were used at fit time only; pending HUMAN M1-H4.

checks.description: Checks recorded for this profile, one per same-sensor pairing that uses it. Result 'pending: no converted samples available' until Adobe DNG Converter samples exist.

matrix3.description: 3x3 matrix, row-major, rows sum to 1 (white preserving). M * [1,1,1] = [1,1,1].

map_class.description: Maps fitted at the class's reference lights, sorted by strictly increasing mired.

w_class.description: w_A of the class's reference lights, sorted by strictly increasing mired; interpolate linearly in mired, clamp at the ends.

w_rgb.description: [r, 1, b]: a white normalised to green = 1.

grid2.description: Uniform temperature grid of 2-vectors: values[i] belongs to start_k + i * step_k. Queries outside the grid clamp to its ends.

grid3.description: Uniform temperature grid of w_A = [r, 1, b].
